id.title: Tentang Rofimain Drilling
id.subtitle: Mitra pondasi tepercaya sejak 2015
id.intro: Rofimain Drilling adalah kontraktor spesialis sumur bor dan pondasi bor pile dengan pengalaman lebih dari satu dekade melayani proyek residensial, komersial, dan infrastruktur di seluruh Indonesia.
id.mission: Memberikan solusi pondasi presisi tinggi dengan peralatan modern dan tim bersertifikat, didukung komitmen transparansi serta garansi pengerjaan.
id.vision: Menjadi mitra kontraktor pondasi terpercaya di Asia Tenggara dengan standar mutu kelas dunia.

en.title: About Rofimain Drilling
en.subtitle: Trusted foundation partner since 2015
en.intro: Rofimain Drilling is a specialist contractor in water wells and bored pile foundations with over a decade of experience serving residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects across Indonesia.
en.mission: Deliver high-precision foundation solutions backed by modern equipment, certified crews, and an uncompromising commitment to transparency and workmanship guarantees.
en.vision: To be Southeast Asia's most trusted foundation contractor with world-class quality standards.
